notes: All benchmark and bounded-load children inherited RLIMIT_AS=8 GiB.
SCHED_FIFO was requested via sudo chrt -f 40; the benchmark self-observed FIFO policy and priority 40 in every FIFO trial.
The host process snapshot includes unrelated pre-existing services; none were stopped or modified.
An unattended package operation was allowed to finish before the suite began.
source_description: portable absolute-sleep wakeup-lateness benchmark; reported generically on Linux
